meta.title: Turn on Show Rank in a Price Based auction
gaps: Ensure the selected existing event is specifically a live Price Based auction.
Verify that ranks are positioned beside Best Price rather than merely appearing somewhere on the screen.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Ensure the selected existing event is specifically a live Price Based auction.; Verify that ranks are positioned beside Best Price rather than merely appearing somewhere on the screen.

steps.note: Open an existing event suitable for the live auction setup.
Open the Actions menu containing the Show Rank control.
Turn on the Show Rank checkbox and confirm its enabled state.
Verify the Best Price content is visible after enabling ranks.
Verify rank-related content is rendered on the auction screen.
